reviews.title: wow, French I can follow
reviews.text: I am so pleased to find something in French I can follow. I answered a few questions and began reading at my level. How the algorithm works, I do not know. But it has opened up a new way of exieriwncing this near forgotten part of my life!

reviews.title: Great for all ages!
reviews.text: I have had an interest in learning to read in Italiano, and I find the books to be very interesting to read, even though as a 74 years old beginner, I already know most of them. I feel I am learning a lot and I look forward to reading the next book. Eppika does a great job of getting new phrases and words in front of me. I am very happy with the app. Don’t think about it, just give it a try!

reviews.title: Really enjoying this language app!
reviews.text: I’ve been reading stories in French for about a week now. The app works well and there is a good variety of books to choose from.  From what I remember of my college French the language seems to be grammatically correct. Idiomatic phrases are introduced more frequently as I progress.  The vocabulary is appropriate to the level and I appreciate the ability to immediately look up unfamiliar words and phrases.  This fits my learning style better than textbook grammar exercises. I’m utilizing the audio most of the time, but it’s quite fast (it’s French after all) and I have to stop and start frequently.  This is a great way for me to refresh my comprehension of the language.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I have been doing Duolingo for about 3 years and there are many things that I still cannot understand. Eppika has been incredible! It has increased my understanding and confidence. I read through the story first. Then I go back and use the “Play Audio” feature to check pronunciation and move at reasonable speed. Finally, I go back through the story really reading for comprehension, marking the words I don’t know and saving them so that I can review them later. I cannot give this any higher rating than a 5, but if I could, I would. Thank you Eppika!

reviews.title: Highly effective
reviews.text: I really can’t vouch for the price, just putting that at the start. I think language learning should be free. Anyway, this app works really well, I’ve been learning French through Duolingo for almost a full year, and just a few days of using Eppika has improved my understanding of French grammar a lot more than my entire time with Duolingo so far. The format is easy to understand and the choice of books are great. Obviously they’re all public domain, but it’s interesting because they’re tailored to specific reading levels. They have more than one version of the same story, I mean to say. It’s fun to read a 1st grade level book, then read the 3rd or 4th grade version.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: The book selections are mostly classics, which means that there is no exposure to contemporary words, terms, and phrases. Not all books even have audio. Translation is for individual words, not phrases, so colloquialisms don’t come across, and, as above, none are contemporary. This app is OK for practice, but I won’t be renewing.

reviews.title: Excellent learning tool
reviews.text: These books have been an excellent learning tool in my journey to learn Spanish. The books provide language structure and build vocabulary in a fun way … using familiar stories. I highly recommend getting this app.

reviews.title: Still loving this app!
reviews.text: This app just keeps getting better and better the more I use it. My listening comprehension has increased tremendously and I look forward to the story of the day every morning. Their story selection and adaptation to elementary level is superb. This is absolutely my favorite learning app of all time.

reviews.title: A fun way to study language
reviews.text: Reading classic stories in abridged form in French is much more entertaining than reading children’s books in French at my current learning stage.  These are all no longer under copyright, and many of them I read in English decades ago.

reviews.title: Great- with great potential
reviews.text:
App works great very few hiccups here and there but it simplifies a very important part of the learning process. Spent over 200 minutes in 2 days and have made progress and am only using the trail version so far.

I WOULD LOVE TO SEE A NEW FEATURE- that pauses or highlights words that you have clicked for a definition AMD OR saved when you re listen/read a story- maybe it could pause and announce the word and its definition while listening- and when the audio is off and you turn to a new page it highlights those words… 🤷‍♂️I think it would be a great feature for us dedicated learners.

reviews.title: Good concept, flawed execution
reviews.text: I love the concept of this app. However I think it would benefit from several improvements. When you click on a word for translation it only translates that word, not the surrounding context which is needed for many phrases and idioms. The app also then frequently freezes when I want to resume listening after clicking on a word. The audio is in an AI voice rather than the natural speaking you would hear in conversation.

reviews.title: Eppika recommendation
reviews.text: Eppika is the perfect companion app for your Spanish studies. You have your instructional books, your Duolingo (or equivalent), maybe an AI tutor. Eppika fits perfectly with it all, giving you excellent language flow at your level of comfort. Give it a try!

reviews.title: Eppika
reviews.text: I am really enjoying this app.  I love reading the stories and learning Spanish at the same time.  It is really helping me conjugate verbs and understand the use of pronouns.  Both of which are difficult for me to do.  I highly recommend this to a person who has a decent vocabulary started and is ready to put it to use.  I am definitely able to produce sentences better now too.  That means I am finally able to Hablo español 😀.  I read first, then listen and read along, then just listen.  You can also review your hardest words with flash cards and hear them spoken correctly.

reviews.title: Customer service?
reviews.text: I never received my notification of renewal after my free trial, which I had to accept in order to see what the app had. I haven’t used it because none of the books appealed to me. I emailed customer service asking for a refund, but no one bothers to reply

reviews.title: Fun and useful, could use more content for high-intermediate and advanced learners
reviews.text: The condensed stories are really good for lower and intermediate levels, but as a more advanced Spanish learner I found that the retellings were a little shorter and more simplified than I would hope. Somewhat simplified prose is fine for practicing fluid reading, but a lot of details that make a story rich are omitted, and characters’ internal thoughts are often overexplained, which can make the content a bit boring after a while. I think advanced learners can be trusted to follow more complex ideas as long as the language is familiar. While I appreciate the inclusion of a few unabridged texts in the newest update, I wish there was something between “intermediate” and “unedited 19th century originals” — retellings that still have the detail and nuance of the originals, but use modern language. If the developers could include some content for learners at this level it would be 5 stars for me.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: This app is so bad. I was recommended it by a friend who said it was great for her so I subscribed for the 3 month period assuming that that would unlock the full books, as opposed to the Ai generated short summaries. When you click on the get full book link, it takes you to a separate Amazon link where you can purchase the physical book for $20. Even with the membership I can’t access the full book, and am stuck with the AI slop versions. I can’t tell that there are any benefits to the membership, really feels like a scam. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: LOVE this app
reviews.text: I use this app almost every night to read before bed. It’s relaxing to me and allows me to “study” Spanish as I wind down for sleep. The ONLY complaint I have is the self-help books (and maybe others? I’m not sure) are books _about_ the book itself, which is not really the same as reading a simplified version of the book, the way the others are written. In other words, instead of having the book be a simplified version of How to win friends and influence people, the book talks about why the book became so popular and what from the book resonated with people.

reviews.title: Amazing app but…
reviews.text: I love this app for learning, the stories are great, the options are plentiful, and it has helped my reading comprehension immensely. The only feature I’d wish they’d add is when you click on a verb to translate it, I’d like it if there was the un conjugated form too. That way you could learn new base verbs as well as their forms. Just an idea, hope y’all like it.

reviews.title: No Free Trial - Not Worth It
reviews.text:
First off - no free trial offered, so you jst have to jump in and pay for the trial period. 

Then, although the concept sounds appealing, my foreign language level is elementary .. so you’d think I’d start out reading elementary-level books? 
No - I started out on Sherlock Holmes. 

I don’t think this app will really help my foreign language comprehension.

reviews.title: Buns
reviews.text: It asks for a free trial as soon as you log in and you can’t try it at all.

reviews.title: False cancellation
reviews.text: I tried this app, and I decided that it was not for me. I canceled this app about a week and a half after downloading it.  Did not use it. I canceled before the date and they still charged me and then when I asked for a refund, they said they do not give refund so I suggest you make sure that you like their product before you commit to it because you will not get your money back they lie

reviews.text: Really bad

reviews.title: My first time reading a story en Español - I loved it.
reviews.text: I diligently filled out what I thought my ability was in Spanish.  My first story was a great and clear read.  Onward! I am 81 and it was still fun and clear to me.

reviews.title: Learning and fun
reviews.text:
I was really surprised how well I understood the stories. I couldn’t understand every word and for those words, I merely had to tap on them and the definition came up as well as a link to hear the word spoken, tapping on the menu, gave a translation for the entire sentence.
So far, I’ve read a Grimm fairytale and a story taken from Alice in Wonderland. 
I’ve read in many places that listening to Spanish text while reading the text is a great learning technique and even better if you say the words along with the reader. This app is designed for all of those things and it’s fun! 
For now, I must go. Alicia is waiting for me al  País de las Maravillas

reviews.title: Support is responsive
reviews.text: Had a problem with the application, no audio . Sent a note to support site got response within a couple hours. The problem (mine!) diagnosed quickly.

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: This app is wonderful with new helpful content every day. There support team is wonderful and helpful and I think this is a great tool for someone looking for more help in learning a language

reviews.title: Charged me during trial period
reviews.text: I am so frustrated. This app charged me during the trial window, I had even cancelled the trial way before it ended. Asked apple for a refund, denied twice. Emailed Eppika’s support line, never responded. Googled if other users experienced this and it said yes, yet this app somehow has great reviews. App is fine, I just wasn’t at the level to enjoy reading yet and thought I would have been.

reviews.title: Best Language App ever
reviews.text: I am amazed at how much my listening comprehension has improved just from reading and listening to books through Eppika. My vocabulary and pronunciation have improved as well. I find the app extremely relaxing to use and I look forward to it every day . And that is saying a lot for a language learning app!

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text:
Terrible app that utilizes AI voice to read AI generated text. They also have a scammy subscription model, I signed up for a free trial however I was still fully charged for the subscription and even when I immediately cancelled, I wasn't refunded. I had to get in touch with Apple and they only offered me a prorated refund for an app that I never used. 

If you are serious about language learning, there are plenty of other resources out there that are not scammy.

reviews.title: Great selection
reviews.text: Great selection tailored to your level and interests

reviews.title: Reading daily!
reviews.text: I was skeptical but this app really works for me. For years I’ve looked for stories I could read in Spanish that weren’t terribly boring or too difficult. The Eppika stories are at my level and they’re interesting. I’m enjoying reading in Spanish - yay!

reviews.title: Excited to try
reviews.text:
I am a teacher and am excited to try this app to further my Spanish that I use for my home life and work. However, I wanted to say that the reason I chose to download is due to the thoughtful responses of the developer to others. Thank you for caring about your customers.

After using the app for a few days:
I love that I could just jump to my intermediate level and begin learning! I have never found a language program that allowed this; and I have searched for years! 

The books are interesting and entertaining. I am enjoying reading in a way I did not expect. I love that I can practice the tenses in Spanish in real time! (Especially past tense!)

I love the feature that will allow me to save words I do not understand. 

I have two suggestions:
1. After I practice the vocabulary word. I would like to use the “hard/ easy” tool. Could you make it sort my words so that I can just review the words I marked “hard” for me? 

Also, I would love a highlight tool. So that I could highlight phrases to review. This would help me to review the hard words together in the context of the story.

reviews.title: Refund issue
reviews.text:
I signed up for the free trial. I did actually try the app once, but didn’t feel it would be hopeful for me to learn Spanish further. I forgot to cancel so that I wouldn’t be charged $89.99 for the year. That was my mistake, I admit. BUT. When I received an email confirming my purchase for the year at 4:37 pm, I requested a refund as quickly as I could, so quickly (because I was so sure I didn’t want to use the app) that I received a confirmation of that refund request at 4:38 pm. I was denied a refund, so I appealed (including providing all of this info) and was denied again. 

An an exception, especially when economically times are difficult, would be helpful. Especially given how quickly I requested a refund when I realized my mistake, From what I understand refund denials are Apple’s decision, not the makers of the app itself, but I couldn’t find a place to review Apple, so I’m posting here. Don’t chance using this app if you might not want it.

reviews.title: Great books but a bit expensive
reviews.text: I did a 7 day free trial and I liked the books and being able to save words, especially for past tense conjugations in the wild but it’s too expensive.

reviews.title: Eveline
reviews.text: I tried this without sound at first and it’s great! I’m at level 94 after 800 days with Duolingo French and this intermediate level story was perfect. I was unsure of a few words but just touched them for a translation. I will go back and read it again along with the narrator to improve my listening skills and accent. Just great!

reviews.title: Great app for readers!
reviews.text:
Love being able to read my favorite stories in my Target language level. It makes it easy to build my vocabulary and see my progress!

I only wish that the bot reader came in different voices and the vocabulary review was more than 10 words at a time.

reviews.title: Way too many errors
reviews.text: Reading the daily stories during my free trial was enjoyable. But reading my first book in Spanish (a simplified version of a novel, El niño de la bola) was a terrible experience. Characters’ names were all mixed up; key details were left out; and some same sentences were repeated again and again, to the extent that it got really boring. Would not recommend this App until these problems get fixed.

reviews.title: Learn vocabulary in context
reviews.text: I love this app! I’m an intermediate Spanish speaker, looking for ways to expand my vocabulary. This is a perfect way to do it. It has been so easy to make it part of my nightly routine. I love it

reviews.title: The French learning is garbage
reviews.text: They want me to pay full price for their French selection which has 1% of the library as Spanish, the books do not translate in context making it useless to a brand new language learner. This is not at all what was advertised

reviews.title: I Like It but…
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for about a month now and I really enjoy the selection of stories at my level. I actually look forward to my daily Spanish reading. But there are a couple things I think could be better. I wish I could save phrases and not just single words. I think a library of common phrases would be helpful for the user. 

The biggest issue for me is when I cannot finish a story in the hours allotted, it just disappears! A new story appears the next day with seemingly no way back to unfinished reading. I was engrossed by some stories I didn’t get to finish (life happens). And while I can see all my completed books, I can’t find my incomplete reading! Am I missing something?

Also, while the story selection is wonderful in simplified Spanish, I found at least one that was very inaccurate (like it was written by AI). I believe the “Hero” of Eppika’s translation of the La Camisa de Margarita is actually the “bad” guy. Am I wrong? Because I enjoy the reading, I often look up the stories after reading them in the app so I was surprised by such an inaccuracy. Of course, many details of the original stories are left out for simplicity but some details actually drive the story and without those details, the story doesn’t really make sense (so far only one story was really confusing because of missing details). I suspect AI to be the culprit. So, I do hope the Spanish pronunciation and phrasing I am learning on Eppika isn’t mangled by AI, as I read a review where someone mentioned the pronunciation is sometimes incorrect.

reviews.title: Gateway
reviews.text: I’m boosting my confidence and enjoying the stories.

reviews.title: Free Versión
reviews.text: Honest review on the free version. It’s just enough mentally for me to read a short story! I love that they are elementary level and max 5-10 minute reads. I definitely think this is a great way to increase vocabulary quickly and it has also helped me learn the past tense better!

reviews.title: Loving it!
reviews.text: I read Lessons in Chemistry and thought the level was perfect - enough challenge but easy enough for there yo be “flow”. I LOVED that I could click on a word to see its meaning and save it. Finally I can read in Spanish without having to stop and look up words!!

reviews.title: It’s great!

reviews.text: I looked for simple Spanish stories but couldn’t find the right level. These are short and interesting and the right level. I get one short story a day for free but am thinking about upgrading to the premium version.
